summary: AFS SenSub Corp., as depositor for GM Financial Consumer Automobile Receivables Trust 2026-4, filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus for a $1,015,780,000 offering of seven classes of automobile receivables-backed notes secured by new and used auto, light-duty truck, and utility vehicle loan contracts. Coupons range from 4.258% (Class A-1) to 5.64% (Class C), with Class A-2-B floating at 30-day SOFR plus 0.37%; monthly distributions begin November 16, 2026. Joint bookrunners include Deutsche Bank, J.P. Morgan, MUFG, SMBC Nikko, and TD Securities. This is a routine ABS shelf takedown, not a special situation.
